sources.EHB7-CROWN: EHB-7 Section 4.4, Crown Maintenance Schedule, 2/8/06 (CROWN/Crown Maintenance Schedule.pdf)
sources.EHB7-ARMSTRONG: EHB-7 Section 4.4, Armstrong Maintenance Schedule, 7/27/16 (ARMSTRONG CLASSIC|G1000B/ArmstrongMaintSched.pdf; 8/2/16 rev: Maint Schedule-Both Armstrong TXs.pdf)
sources.CROWN-UM: Crown Weather Radio (User) Manual, Rev B (CROWN/CROWN User Manual.pdf)

statusKey.confirmed: Value appears verbatim in the cited source (verified against rendered PDF page where extraction was ambiguous)
statusKey.derived: Not stated verbatim for this exact reading; borrowed or computed from a closely related spec in the cited source - REVIEW THESE
statusKey.alarm: Manufacturer protection/alarm threshold from the manual, not a PMI pass/fail tolerance - exceeding it means the hardware itself would fold back or trip; useful as a hard sanity limit
statusKey.unknown: No numeric tolerance found in the docs; EHB-7 says compare with previous readings (trend only). No flagging will be applied

checkTypes.range: flag if value < min or > max
checkTypes.nominal_pct: flag if value outside nominal +/- pct%; nominal may be the literal number or the symbol 'licensedPowerW'
checkTypes.nearest_nominal_pct: flag if value outside +/- pct% of the NEAREST value in allowedNominals (used for AC mains where site wiring varies)
checkTypes.pct_of_field: flag if value > maxPct% of the referenced field's entered value (reflected vs forward)
checkTypes.agreement_pct: flag if value differs from the referenced field's entered value by more than pct% (panel vs external wattmeter)
checkTypes.freq_error_hz: flag if |entered MHz - site licensed frequency| > toleranceHz
checkTypes.spread_max_amps: flag if (max - min) across the listed sibling fields exceeds warnAmps (soft) / alarmAmps (hard)
checkTypes.expect_yes: flag if the yes/no radio is answered 'no'
checkTypes.max_age_years: flag if the entered date is more than years old at inspection date

$meta.nearLimitRule: Soft 'near limit' warning when a value is inside tolerance but past 80% of the distance from nominal (or range center) to the limit. Applied generically in Step 2 to every numeric check.
sourceDiscrepancies: Armstrong Attachment E form {6} prints '(Within +/- 500 Hz)' but the procedure table (p. A-12 {6}) and on-site procedure (p. A-27) say +/-200 Hz; the annotated 7/27/16 copy strikes 500 and hand-corrects to '+/- 200 Hz'. Config uses +/-200 Hz.

Armstrong Attachment E form {7} asks 'Value is +/- 4.8 kHz on CRT?' while the procedure text (p. A-28 {7}) says nominal ~4.5 kHz, not to exceed 5 kHz. The app already renders 4.8 for Armstrong. Config keeps the yes/no checks as expect_yes and the hard 5.0 kHz cap; no numeric 4.8-vs-4.5 flagging is applied.
Crown carrier tolerance is +/-500 Hz per its schedule, looser than Nautel/Armstrong (+/-200 Hz). The app's step-4 note currently says 'Within +/-200 Hz' for all platforms - cosmetic fix in Step 2.

Crown 1kW PA1-8 balance: EHB-7 note recommends keeping the eight currents within 0.5-0.7 A of each other; the Crown manual (WR1000PA troubleshooting 5.2.8) uses >= 2.5 A difference as the troubleshoot threshold. Config warns at 0.7 A spread, hard-flags at 2.5 A.
unknowns: Nautel PA Volts A/B: typically 27 V, operational range 7-53 V, power-dependent (NG1000-OM p. SD/power supply section) - no PMI tolerance; trend only
Nautel low-level rails +48/+15/-15/+5/+3.3/+1.8 VDC: rail names imply nominals but no +/- tolerance is published; trend only
Nautel PA1-8 / Preamp / IPA / Total PA currents: no numeric spec; trend only
Nautel Fan Tach 1-5 RPM: no spec; trend only
Nautel Active PA Power and IPA Fwd Power: IPA nominal 150 W (NG1000-OM 'last stage provides 150 W nominal as IPA output'); no tolerance; trend only
Crown 1kW (WA1000) PA Temp: no numeric spec found for the 1kW amp (the 35-50 C / 75 C figures are for the WR100/300 chassis); trend only
Crown 1kW ACC reading: no spec found (the 3.00-6.00 V ALC spec is for the WR100/300 panel); trend only
Crown 1kW In Ref (panel reflected): no numeric panel spec; the 4%-of-forward rule is stated for the external wattmeter; trend only
Crown 1kW exciter (100/300 panel) PA DC V/A while driving the WA1000 at ~50 W: the 35-50 V / 12-16 A specs assume full-power standalone operation; trend only in 1kW systems

Armstrong (both) external forward power as % of licensed power: Armstrong schedule states no number (Crown says +/-10%, Nautel +/-5%); only the panel-vs-external 5% agreement check is stated; ext fwd is left as derived +/-10% for review
Armstrong Classic FMX-80 exciter power nominal: not found; trend only

Armstrong Classic / G1000B PA voltage-current typical values: supply is nominally 50 VDC (AGC-controlled, varies with power); only alarm maxima are published; PA V flagged only as derived range around 50 V - review
